Reference / url/percent

url/percent#

Percent-encoding of URL parts (RFC 3986).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

PercentEncoded(origin: "a b/c", component: UrlComponent.path_segment).string();   // "a%20b%2Fc"
PercentDecoded("a%20b").string();                               // "a b"

Description#

Percent-encoding of URL parts (RFC 3986).

What is kept as it is depends on the component the text goes in.

Public API#

enum UrlComponent#

enum UrlComponent = (data, userinfo, path_segment, path, query, fragment)

Whole-component choices preserve their grammatical separators. Use data for a single query name/value. These choices do not validate URL structure.

UrlComponent.data#

data

UrlComponent.userinfo#

userinfo

path_segment

query

object PercentEncoded#

object PercentEncoded

Encode decoded text exactly once; '%' is data even in a preexisting %HH. Non-ASCII scalars are UTF-8 encoded before escaping individual octets.

PercentEncoded.PercentEncoded#

PercentEncoded(origin is string, component is UrlComponent)

Encodes origin for component.

PercentEncoded.string#

string() is string

The encoded text.

object PercentDecoded#

object PercentDecoded

Percent grammar is checked when observed. Literal Unicode contributes UTF-8; '+' stays '+'. bytes() supports binary output; string() preserves InvalidUtf8.

PercentDecoded.PercentDecoded#

PercentDecoded(origin is string)

Decodes origin.

PercentDecoded.bytes#

bytes() is @byte

Literal runs between escapes are encoded whole, not one character at a time (#503); text without '%' is its own UTF-8.

PercentDecoded.string#

string() is string

The decoded text; InvalidPercentEncoding for a bad escape or bytes that are not UTF-8.

Errors#

enum InvalidPercentEncoding#

enum InvalidPercentEncoding is Error = (at(offset is int))

A bad % escape, or bytes that are not UTF-8; offset says where.

InvalidPercentEncoding.at#

at(offset is int)
